name: Miyama (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyama city emblem in green: a stylised flower of five leaf-like petals.
history: Municipal flag of Miyama, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 January 2007.

features.role: Miyama city emblem — a stylised flower of five leaf-like petals
